source.label: thm:lower
source.quote: For any $K$ and $K^*< K$ and $\Delta \in (0,1/2)$ the regret of any  {\em consistent} algorithm on the $K^*$-Set instance is lower bounded as $\lim\limits_{T\to \infty} \tfrac{R^{1}_T}{ \log T}  \geq \tfrac{(K-K^*)}{\Delta} $.

results.notes: R^1_T is 1-regret (OPT minus expected reward), equal to regret vs Oracle Greedy here. Proof's bound Delta/KL <= 1/(4 Delta) seems to go in the wrong direction for a lower bound; recorded as stated.
